# draw (draw.marcopontili.com)

> Browser whiteboard built on Excalidraw, with LaTeX math, Mermaid-to-shapes and sanitized Markdown inserts. Runs in the browser, works offline, and stores the scene only in localStorage.

Live app: https://draw.marcopontili.com/

## When to use

Use this app when an agent or person needs to sketch a diagram, place rendered LaTeX, or turn Mermaid code into editable shapes, then export the result.

**Good fits**

- Build or edit an Excalidraw scene and export it as PNG or SVG
- Round-trip `.excalidraw` JSON through a live editor
- Drive the live UI from a coding agent with Playwriter

**Prefer something else for**

- Server-side or headless batch rendering (this product has no backend)
- Hosted MCP tools (none; see `/auth.md`)
- Search indexing (the app is intentionally `noindex`)

## How agents control the app

1. Open https://draw.marcopontili.com/ (or a local Vite server on port 5173).
2. Wait until `window.draw` is defined.
3. Call `await window.draw.setScene(json)` with `.excalidraw` JSON (`type: "excalidraw"`, `elements` array, max 20 MB).
4. Read the scene back with `window.draw.getScene()` (`.excalidraw` JSON string).
5. Export with `await window.draw.exportImage("png")` (data URL) or `await window.draw.exportImage("svg")` (SVG markup).

Skill: https://draw.marcopontili.com/.well-known/agent-skills/draw-scene/SKILL.md (Playwriter procedure).

- [For agents](https://draw.marcopontili.com/for-agents.html): portal inventory

- [ARD catalog](https://draw.marcopontili.com/.well-known/ard.json)
- [Agent skills index](https://draw.marcopontili.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)

## Notes

- No accounts, API keys, OAuth, or hosted MCP.
- Scenes stay in the browser session; nothing is uploaded.
- Crawlers remain disallowed in `robots.txt` by design; this file is for agents that already have the URL.
